setting: You are all in Toronto, Canada, and you know each other through a shared friend, from different parts of that friend's life: university, work, the climbing gym and the neighbourhood. This chat gets used for planning a small get-together before the holidays and for trading tips on getting through the late-November cold.

Share a photo of the first snow on your balcony
Check whether anyone still has spare gym passes

situation: Friends from different parts of my life.

text: Who's free for dinner sat 🙏
Ooh yes. I'm free 🙌
Saturday works for me. Where to?
Not sure yet, somewhere not too far from the subway. Open to ideas
The thai place on queen? They have the booths in back
Oh yes. Good call 😊
I can do Sat. Thai is fine.
Ok so far me, yuki, victor, samir
Queen St is loud on a Saturday. Ask for the back.
We'll be in the back. I promise 😂
[photo: my balcony this morning, the railing is gone under snow]
Oof 😭 it's only december
Wool socks and a hat that covers the ears. Toques don't do it at minus 15.
The hat thing is so true. I learned that the hard way 🧣
Bought the ugly hat that covers everything now. No shame
Is the Sat booking under one name?
I'll put it under me. 7:30?
7:30 is good for me
7:30 works.
Booked. 7:30, back booth, under jasmine will confirm the day before
Plow came down the street at 6. Car's buried anyway
Ugh. Need a hand digging out?
Got nothing but time. I'll manage
Is anyone else's office heating broken? Mine is 19 degrees and I'm at my desk in my coat
Ours is fine. Sorry
Rude
Ok hat people, pom or no pom
No pom. Catches the wind
Pom not getting rid of mine
2 vs 1, pom stays 😤
Anyone driving Sat? Parking near Queen is a nightmare
I'm taking the bus. Side streets east of Queen are fine after 7 if you're driving
Good to know. Thanks
Going to bed, 6am alarm 😴 please no snow day tomorrow 🙏
Up. Not a snow day, sadly 😩
Salted the walk. Still ice under it, careful going out
[photo: balcony railing, about half cleared]
Got about half. The kid next door is helping for hot chocolate 😂
Ok that's the most Toronto thing I've seen all week
Heat's back on. Took them two hours and a space heater
Glad. Ours was fine btw
Still rude
Victor, street parking near the restaurant after 7 or should I just use the lot on Shuter
Street. Lot's 12 after 6 and you'll still walk the same distance
Ok street
Do we pay on the night or does the place want a card now
Pay on the night, no deposit. Said they'd hold the back booth
Perfect
Plow came back through. Car is still buried. Going to leave it till spring
Victor 😭 you're going to get a parking ticket on a snowbank
Ok I'm done. Night 😴
Night
